section.content: 本发明提供种半导体集成电路，包括经由通孔而彼此耦合的多个半导体芯片，其中，多个半导体芯片中的最下层的半导体芯片被配置为产生第测试脉冲信号并且经由通孔来发送第测试脉冲信号，多个半导体芯片中的最上层的半导体芯片被配置为在与第测试脉冲信号大体保持时间差的同时产生第二测试脉冲信号，并且经由通孔来发送第二测试脉冲信号，多个半导体芯片被配置为响应于第测试脉冲信号和第二测试脉冲信号而产生用于判定通孔是否有缺陷的测试结果信号。

The present invention provides a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, including the multiple semiconductor chips coupled to each other via through hole, wherein, undermost semiconductor chip in multiple semiconductor chips is configured as producing the first test pulse signal and sends the first test pulse signal via through hole, the semiconductor chip of the superiors in multiple semiconductor chips is configured as producing the second test pulse signal while the time difference is generally maintained with the first test pulse signal, and send the second test pulse signal via through hole, multiple semiconductor chips are configured to respond to the first test pulse signal and the second test pulse signal and produced for judging the whether defective test result signal of through hole.

Semiconductor integrated circuitThe cross reference of related application

This application claims on 2 14th, the 2012 Application No. 10-2012-0014856 submitted to Korean Intellectual Property Office Korean patent application priority, entire contents are incorporated herein by reference.

Technical field

Present invention is generally directed to a kind of semiconductor circuit, more particularly, to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background technology

In order to improve integrated level, semiconductor integrated circuit is manufactured by being laminated multiple chips.

As one of them, the through hole to semiconductor integrated circuit has energetically been carried out（For example, break-through silicon hole （TSV））Research.

According to this method, it is laminated multiple chips and forms break-through silicon hole so that all chips are coupled to each other.

In the semiconductor integrated circuit using break-through silicon hole, various defects may be produced in the fabrication process.That is, There may be it is such as following the defects of：Represent the cavity of the unfilled break-through silicon hole of conductive material, due to chip bending or projection Bump contact failure caused by material movement, or the caused slight crack in break-through silicon hole.

When producing the defects of such, it may not be possible to the transmission of various signals or the supply of power supply are performed between the chips, Cause the serious operating mistake in semiconductor integrated circuit.

Thus, it is necessary to perform reparation according to the result of caused test and test for determining these defects Operation.

In the prior art, one kind is used for using external device (ED) to check outside output to semiconductor integrated circuit Test signal and cut off repair fuse method.

However, because semiconductor integrated circuit includes multiple break-through silicon holes, in order to test the defects of producing in through-holes And defect is repaired, it is necessary to observe through hole or storage volume of data using external device (ED) and use repair procedure etc..

Therefore, in the semiconductor integrated circuit according to prior art, testing time and the data relevant with test increase Add, testing efficiency is reduced due to the limitation of available channel and the memory of test equipment, and extraly needs to be used to perform The time of operation is repaired, causes the manufacture yield of semiconductor integrated circuit to decline.

The content of the invention

The present invention illustrates a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that can reduce testing time and repair time.

In one embodiment, a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit includes：The multiple semiconductors coupled to each other via through hole Chip, wherein, the undermost semiconductor chip in multiple semiconductor chips is configured as producing the first test pulse signal simultaneously And sending the first test pulse signal via through hole, the semiconductor chip of the superiors in multiple semiconductor chips is configured as The second test pulse signal is produced while the time difference is generally maintained with the first test pulse signal, and is sent out via through hole The second test pulse signal is sent, multiple semiconductor chips are configured to respond to the first test pulse signal and the second test pulse Signal and produce for judging the whether defective test result signal of through hole.

In one embodiment, a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit includes：The multiple semiconductors coupled to each other via through hole Chip, wherein, the undermost semiconductor chip in multiple semiconductor chips is configured as producing the first test pulse signal simultaneously And sending the first test pulse signal via through hole, the semiconductor chip of the superiors in multiple semiconductor chips is configured as The second test pulse signal is produced while the time difference is generally maintained with the first test pulse signal, and is sent out via through hole The second test pulse signal is sent, multiple semiconductor chips are configured to respond to the first test pulse signal and the second test pulse Signal and produce for judging the whether defective test result signal of through hole, and in response to test result signal come change with The signal path of defective through hole coupling is to repair through hole.

In the semiconductor integrated circuit according to one embodiment, testing time and repair time are reduced, and bring manufacture to produce The raising of rate.
